notes.title: Cat Burglar ver 5-7 released
notes.content:
We have resolved the 2 largest bugs that were shared with us:
1. Save data bug - FIXED
2. Mouse camera bug - FIXED

We thank you for your patience and hope you will continue to help us improve the game. 

We still have lots more in mind and you are truly helping us make something great.

notes.title: HotFix Cat Burglar 3-97
notes.content: We discovered through the support of our community that level 7, turned into level 6. That has been corrected and we thank you for all the support.

notes.title: We are released!!! Cat Burglar Ver 3.8
notes.content:
Thanks to all the support and feedback from the Steam community we have polished things up and added achievements. We hope you enjoy the more refined Cat Burglar experience.

We will be doing bug fixes as quickly as we can, please feel free to help support our project with the DLC support <3

notes.title: Cat Burglar Patch 3.3 notes
notes.content:
We want to apologize for taking a long time to update Cat Burglar as we are learning the process and working on a couple other games. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/937350/Food_Drive_Race_against_Hunger/](Food Drive available now)[/url]

We are now coming back around and putting some polish on Cat Burglar to increase its fun and replayability. Keep your eyes open for new content as we move forward and towards Release.

[b]Patch 3.3 changes[/b]

[b]Control bugs resolved[/b]
[*] Keyboard resetting bugs removed.
[*] Xbox and Logitec controller bugs fixed.
[*] PS4 controller is no longer supported.

[b]Tutorial image added to pause menu[/b]
[*]  Controls for everyone who misses the signs in level 1. 

[b]Adjusted path on enemy dogs[/b]
[*] Evil seeing throgh wall dog on level 4 reworked.
[*] Improved pathing adjustments on other dogs.
[*] Improved pathing visibility

Sound Options screen adjustments
Volume reduced on pick up items

notes.title: Patch #2 Control and Collision
notes.content:
Today's patch has controls more streamlines and all access removed. Xbox and PC controllers should all work correctly now, PS4 controllers are still being difficult and will be dealt with in later patch if possible.

We removed the few remaining collision bugs that we observed through gameplay streams or were given feedback on.

We are hoping to have another patch here fairly shortly with an options menu, with audio options, resolution settings and an inversion option for the controls.

Thanks for all the feedback, please keep it coming and we will try to address everything we can. Thanks for the support.
